Module com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku
Package com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.board

Interface ISudokuBoard

All Known Implementing Classes:
SudokuBoard
public interface ISudokuBoard
Interface that defines the operations and behaviors required for managing a Sudoku board. Provides methods for accessing, modifying, and retrieving the current game state.
